comment: Dr Lundberg is the sweetest person. She emphasizes a lot that she prioritizes learning over grades. She wants you to learn and be passionate about the material. Intro psych is a pretty boring class since the content is very basic so the lectures weren't super engaging. But her tests are very straight forward and the quizzes are in groups. TAKE HER

She's a caring professor and the course is relatively easy with her. Grade based on 3 midterms, daily group quizzes, some research assignments, and a final group project mainly. Exams are relatively easy. Reading textbook is helpful, but I didn't and it was fine as long as you pay attention to lectures and skim terms.
I absolutely love her classes! She's an amazing professor—challenging but in the best way possible. Her grading can be tough, but it's definitely worth it because you learn so much. Highly recommend!

So genuine and really cared about getting student feedback. Interesting course because no exams were given, just writing assignments. Tough grading but gives lots of feedback for improvement. I enjoyed taking her course.

She's a great teacher, and I've really learned a lot in her class this year! I've worked pretty hard, but I'm still not sure where I stand grade-wise (maybe an A or A-?). Her weekly challenges are definitely tough, and she sets high expectations. If you don't keep up with the readings, it's hard to get a good grade. :(

Dr. Lundberg had very engaging lectures. She incorporated activities to make sure we were paying attention and even learned everyone's names despite not having met some of us. She was passionate about the subject and shared how we could apply the concepts we learned to real life.

By far my favorite Professor at Richmond, NO ONE else cares more about their students than her. She is a tough grader, but she is SO willing to help you throughout the process. The class itself is phenomenal, and definitely worth taking for the subject matter alone. One of the earliest chances you get to do a personal research project that's YOURS.

I took 2 tests in her "Science of Emotion" elective before opting for a late withdrawal (which my dean had to fight for because she was reluctant despite dealing with mental illness), and I received a failing grade on both tests. I work hard and study thoroughly, but even meeting with her and changing my study plan did not grant me a passing grade.

LOVE HER but frustrating at times. Took a month to grade tests, HIGH expectations with little leniency/stubborn. Class is HARD but worth it. She is so caring and passionate. HUGE indiv research project but makes it accessible/fun almost. Tests are the killers. Think you did well but nope HARD grader. Few As to those who rly work. You should take it

Dr. Lundberg is absolutely fantastic, she's very sweet and you can really tell she puts a lot of effort into preparing for each and very class. She caters to students very well and is always available for questions/reachable via email. Her grading criteria are clear and although her 2 exams (midterm and final) are challenging they are do-able!

Dr. Lundberg is an amazing professor! The class is definitely a bit difficult, but if you put in the work, you most definitely reap the benefits. The exams are difficult but there's only two, and there are a lot of opportunities for points from lab and other assignments. She's super accessible, and cares a lot about her students.

Professor Lundberg is a fantastic professor. Her Emotion class is extremely interesting and well connected to theory and everyday life. Exams are difficult, very important to study hard and plan ahead, but she's a fair grader overall. Ways to make up for low exam scores if you get your assignments in on time. VERY accessible and loves her students!

Dr. Lundberg cares about her students more than most. She clearly puts a lot of effort into preparing lectures and demonstrates a great understanding of the material she teaches. She is also very clear in her expectations of students. Offers review sessions before tests and is always open to meet with students. Very supportive and fun!

Dr. Lundberg is a really sweet professor who is passionate about what she teaches. She's a tough grader, but tries her best to have her students learn and understand the material. She doesn't post her powerpoints, but she has outlines of her powerpoints, so show up to class and take thorough notes. Otherwise, the textbook isn't needed, but helps.
